prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Houston, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1381; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just say my name is not needed here, but if it's required, I can confirm I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was on a multi-lane city street in Houston, Texas, heading toward the on-ramp area. Traffic was moving steadily.
Q: Walk me through what you were doing right before the impact.
A: I was in the right lane and wanted to move over to the left lane because a delivery truck ahead was slowing down. I checked my mirror and looked over my shoulder, but I think the other car was in my blind spot.
Q: Did you signal before changing lanes?
A: Yes, I put my turn signal on a few seconds before I started to move.
Q: What happened when you moved over?
A: The other vehicle sideswiped the rear quarter panel of my car. I felt a hard jolt and heard the scraping sound. I steered back toward the shoulder and stopped.
Q: Were you injured at the scene?
A: Not obviously. I was stiff, but I thought I would be fine. By the next morning my neck was tight and my lower back was sore, especially when I sat for long periods.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to a clinic and was told I have a neck and back strain. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I've been careful to follow the treatment plan and I'm willing to provide my medical records.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
